description: Land Acquisition - Lewella, Kandy Four Gravets D/S Division, Kandy District - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 2016/32 of 26.04.2017 extending inquiry dates
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it concerns "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
